voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Rapa Nui, Easter Island. In eighteen sixty-four, a missionary wrote of carved wooden tablets in almost every house.
Rows of tiny figures. Each line runs the other way, and the tablet is turned to read it.
In the eighteen-sixties, slave raids and disease devastated the island. Many who knew the script were lost.
About two dozen carved objects survive. In twenty twenty-four, the wood of one was radiocarbon-dated to around fifteen hundred.
One passage may be a lunar calendar. No reading of the script has ever been accepted.
